covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for ULW C5 (parent GB-1544), authored by muse-b3 as author of record (CB-0828) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-C5.md (fixer muse-b2), build e305ef8a2 on branch walker/ultimate-lens-walker (parent 5c51ef99d; DRAFT PR #2359). What was built: in checks.py LensWalk, settle (networkidle) time accumulates across every navigation of a walk into settle_spent_s, bounded by thresholds.settle_budget_s (config 60); settle_allowance_ms() = min(settle_ms_judgment, remaining budget), and once the budget is spent the idle wait is SKIPPED (settled=False, settle_capped=True on the timing row) instead of burning the full 15s judgment timeout per navigation — the ~727s settle burn the audit cites; the timing judgment names the cap when a settle was capped, so a capped settle never reads as a lens fault; result['settle'] = {spent_s, budget_s, capped}. Per-CHECK budgets: thresholds.check_budget_s (config 90) default + check_budgets_s per-phase overrides; run() times every phase (_begin_phase/_end_phase); each check row is stamped elapsed_s / budget_s / over_check_budget; result['check_budgets'] carries the per-check account; the tabs and openers loops break on phase_over(), so a slow early phase's cost is accounted to that check, not silently to the lens. Provenance: INDEPENDENT (behavioural selftest, pristine control). LIMITS, as filed: per-check enforcement is phase-granular — a single monolithic phase call cannot be interrupted mid-call; the loop phases stop early and every phase's overspend is stamped; the settle cap bounds the idle waits in checks.py _nav — repro.py's own wait is out of this ticket's named scope. Tier 1 is PROPOSED in the check file — assigned at acceptance by the reviewer. Reviewer: activation on walker replay against the deployed build; PR #2359 stays DRAFT.
